# ALB Design Studio (concept by Kerblabs)

> Residential design studio in Charlotte, North Carolina. Founder and principal designer Angie Lauer, AIA Associate, with more than 35 years of residential design experience (per albdesign.studio).

- Services (their site): design review consulting, historic renovations, remodeling and additions, custom home design
- Area: Charlotte and surrounding areas
- Email: angie@albdesign.studio
- Site: https://albdesign.studio

## FAQ
- Who runs the studio? Angie Lauer, founder and principal designer.
- What do they do? Design review consulting, historic renovations, remodeling and additions, custom home design.
- How do I reach them? Email angie@albdesign.studio; their site offers consultation booking.

This page is a free concept by Kerblabs, not affiliated with the studio.
